Q01.answer:
**(a)** Non-poison Chaos hits damage Energy Shield first. Each 1 point of Chaos damage after mitigation removes 2 Energy Shield. Once the shield is depleted, any remaining Chaos damage applies to Life at 1:1.

**(b)** Yes. Both Bleeding and Poison bypass Energy Shield and deal their damage over time directly to Life.

**(c)** No. Only physical hit damage dealt to **Life** contributes to Bleeding. A hit fully absorbed by Energy Shield cannot inflict it. If a hit takes the CI character’s sole point of Life, the hit itself kills them.
